profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Visa | Texas A&M Alum
profile.summary: Howdy! My name is Dexter White and I am a Senior Computer Science Major (and cybersecurity minor) at Texas A&M University. If I had to categorize myself in my own words, I would choose hardworking, optimistic, and a great team member! Since realizing computer science was a passion of mine in high school, I have accumulated several years of experience in Java and C++, as well as worked with Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL. When it comes to Web Development, I have experience with both front-end and back-end development, which include Spring Boot, React.js, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Python Flask, and Node,js. I have worked quite a bit with Unix, and I also have enterprise-level Git and Agile experience! A little fun fact about myself is that in my time here at Texas A&M, my team and I actually placed second at the 2021 TAMUhack hackathon! Currently, I am looking for a full time post-graduation software engineering position!

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Implemented a Spring Boot application dependency mapping service for over 130 internal applications.
Established and a new relational database table for the dependency mappings, which was utilized by the dependency mapping service.
Incorporated the service’s data (via RESTful API) onto an internal ReactJS application using Redux, expediting the process of debugging potential unhealthy for other developers.
Utilized Redux and a different back-end service to display additional accountability information on the same ReactJS site.
Delivered project features using enterprise-level Git and Jira (Agile) practices and procedures.
